records.summary: Added Elliptic's 05:00 UTC Binance incident update and a fresh Binance PoR schedule check. Elliptic's approximately 04:30 UTC holdings snapshot reports 233M XRP unchanged, $3.21B of assets outside issuer-freeze control, $2.85B frozen/seized, major USDT-to-ETH swaps, an Aave collateral/borrow position near liquidation, Circle CCTP use and likely-but-unconfirmed TraderTraitor attribution. CoinDesk's Binance 14 reserve crosswalk is ETH-specific and does not establish XRPL wallet membership. Re-audited current main and 180 open PRs. Created fresh-main draft PR #1406 to prevent post-horizon price leakage in fixed-horizon outcomes (374 tests + 8 subtests, gate passed) and PR #1407 to remove scheduler write/dispatch authority while preserving scheduled read-only queue visibility (344 tests + 8 subtests, gate passed). PR #1404 and #1405 also have green exact-head CI/gates. All remain draft/unmerged; main retains scheduled writers. No market features admitted and no forecast issued.
